verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a hosted workflow-orchestration platform, but the evidence pack documents no data export feature or open-format export for workflows, runs, or logs. Self-hosting the control plane and the Postgres-backed queue are related to avoiding lock-in, but they are a different capability, not a documented export-and-leave path, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
